selection.objective: Minimize canonical public-key plus one ciphertext bytes; ties: public-key bytes, p, q, decreasing w
fixed_constraints: Full uniform ideal-model samplers and the 2020 transform/encodings
p,q prime; p mod4=1; q mod6=1; x^p-x-1 irreducible modulo q
32-byte output; no padding or forced timing
selection.domain: Inherited certified degrees through653; at each p, old q plus first admissible q above16*floor(a*p/8)+1 for a=1,2,3,4, bounded by q<16384 and q<=16*floor(2p/3)+1. Test maximum correctness-admissible weight at each q and the old weight at oldq.
selection.scope: Minimum only among the listed finite candidates under the scoped reference, not a global or full-security optimum
selection.timing: No runtime/memory dominance claimed; increased weight can increase sampler work
selection.targets: Uncalibrated introductory tuples screened for increasing bytes and exact input-enumeration ceilings below the first calibrated cost; then distinct minimum-communication tuples at4-bit classical hybrid-inclusive reference targets through128
selection.omissions: Dual/structural attacks, memory cost, side channels, full-KEM proof losses and concrete small-dimension reliability. The hybrid model includes simple and meet-in-the-middle guessing; neither this estimate nor Core-SVP is a security lower bound.
selection.input_enumeration: 2^w*C(p,w) candidate input-polynomial re-encryptions, reported separately from Core-SVP units

certificate.meaning: Algebra/encoding conditions, not a confidentiality certificate
